subtitle: Snap the flies, spare the bees
description:
Gulpwort is a quick arcade timing game about three hungry flytraps on a sunny windowsill. Flies, gnats, moths and dragonflies buzz in to sniff at their open jaws. Tap the left, middle or right of the screen to snap that plant's jaws shut, and catch the bug while it is inside.

All three plants get hungrier every second, and each one has its own belly to fill. Bugs fly wherever they like, so you keep an eye on three jaws at once. Let a plant go hungry for too long and it wilts. Wilt three times and the run is over.

The stems sway, the bugs loop and dart, and the timing gets sharper as the minutes go by. Snap two or three bugs in one bite for a big gulp bonus, and chain clean snaps for a growing multiplier. But a plant that just ate needs a moment to chew, and an empty snap costs it a little belly.

Bees visit too, and bees are friends. Snap one by mistake and it stings. Feed a plant past full and it blooms for double points, but bees love flowers, so a blooming plant is where the bees go.

Bright sticker-book art, one-tap controls, short runs and a best score to beat. Plays offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: Three hungry flytraps, one tap each. Snap the flies, gulp the gnats, chase the moths and never eat a bee. Keep every plant fed for as long as you can.
reviewNote: Tap to start. Tap the left, middle or right of the screen to snap that flytrap's jaws shut when a bug is inside them, and avoid snapping bees. The game ends when the plants have wilted from hunger three times.
